findings.passage: Call on the legislature to pass and sign into law a commonsense Voter ID law for the Commonwealth to ensure the promise of one person, one vote is protected in Pennsylvania.
findings.note: Statement issued by the Garrity for PA campaign (reported by PoliticsPA, page dated March 11, 2026), after a federal charge against a non-citizen for voting. Calls on the governor to urge the legislature to pass a voter ID law.

findings.passage: Institute new protocols to coordinate with federal immigration enforcement to ensure Pennsylvania’s voter rolls do not have illegal immigrants or anyone who otherwise should not qualify to vote. Currently, Pennsylvania requires a driver’s license number or the last four digits of your Social Security number, which the Commonwealth uses to verify voter status. It is clear that this process is flawed.
findings.note: Statement issued by the Garrity for PA campaign (reported by PoliticsPA, page dated March 11, 2026), after a federal charge against a non-citizen for voting. Calls for coordination with federal immigration enforcement on voter rolls and says the current license-number or Social Security check is flawed.

findings.passage: This same Gallup poll found that 83% of Americans support requiring proof of citizen when registering to vote for the first time – something that would have stopped Mr. Sacko from ever casting a ballot.
findings.note: Statement issued by the Garrity for PA campaign (reported by PoliticsPA, page dated March 11, 2026), after a federal charge against a non-citizen for voting.
